Unquoted person-shaped From, non-role local-part, Return-Path local == From local, resolved >=200-char prose, every list / noreply / ESP signal zeroed: ONLY Rule 9 can decide this row, so it fails iff the person-sender exemption regresses.

raw_content.text: Hi Rowan, it was great meeting you at the open house on Saturday. I have been thinking about the microfluidics protocol you described and I think there is a real overlap with what our group is doing on droplet sorting. Would you be open to a short call next week to compare notes? I can send over the two papers I mentioned beforehand so we have something concrete to react to. Either Tuesday or Thursday afternoon works on my side, but I am flexible if another slot suits you better.
